The '''Third Guard''' was an [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]] who served as a personal [[Bodyguard|guard]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]], leader of the [[First Order]]. While serving the Supreme Leader, the Third Guard used a [[Bilari electro-chain whip]]. The guard was [[Death|killed]] on board the ''[[Supremacy]]'' when [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], Snoke's apprentice, betrayed the Supreme Leader with the help of [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], another [[Force-sensitive]] individual. Together they defeated and killed all of the Elite Praetorian Guards in the [[Snoke's throne room|throne room]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Biography==
The Third [[Bodyguard|Guard]] was a member of the [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]]—[[Color|crimson]] [[Soldier|warriors]] who served as the personal bodyguards of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]] of the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The Third Guard was stationed in [[Snoke's throne room]] with a [[bilari electro-chain whip]] along with the other Praetorian Guards at the [[time]] of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] audience with the Supreme Leader<ref name="Episode VIII" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Angered by Snoke's disapproving appraisal of his [[Battle of Starkiller Base|defeat]] on [[Starkiller Base]],<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> the [[Ren|Master]] of the [[Knights of Ren]] took a step in his master's direction, causing the Third Guard and their fellow guards to snap into a combat stance against the [[Dark side of the Force|dark]] apprentice as Snoke electrocutes him with [[force lightning]].<ref name="Expanded Edition">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

The Third Guard was still present in the [[throne]] room when Ren returned with the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan|learner]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] as his [[prisoner]]. However, instead of executing the former [[scavenger]] as Snoke ordered, Ren chose to [[assassin]]ate his master—resulting in a [[Battle of Oetchi|confrontation]] between the two [[Force-sensitive]]s and the Praetorian Guards. Like the other Praetorians, the Third Guard attempted to avenge the slain Supreme Leader,<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> engaging the traitorous apprentice and Rey. After the death of one of their fellow guards, one of the guards with a chain-whip entangled [[Skywalker lightsaber|Rey's lightsaber]] with their chain whip and pulled her towards them, after which they grabbed her from the throat to pierce it with the sharp edge of his weapon. But Rey broke free from the weapon and fatally cut the guard from their groin to the back. The remaining Praetorians were soon killed also, including the other guard wielding a chain-whip who was decapitated by Ren.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
